# Donor: hsoliwal/synexia-m3scale-apache2 develop 3385d79a2968c770aedf1d3398b2a62f05ebc092 (2026-11-06): the older, broader catalogue src/main/java/com/synexia/m3scale/algorithms (21 files, 4,894 LOC; last substantive change 9af4ac4e 2026-09-25, restored 99f80871 2026-10-27), built upstream only through the root monolith pom.

# Per-method NEC (METHOD_CENSUS.tsv, rule P1 there): a donor member whose catalogue problem a landed jdk.m3.algorithm method (families-20261106, graph-trie-20261106) or another built M3JDK owner already answers is removed by one DROP_METHOD or DROP_TYPE row naming that owner (the landed body wins: the 2026-11-05 boundary fixes exist only in the landed lineage); members the drops strand are removed by closure rows; a non-ABSORB member stays only as the closure of a kept member (listed in the census, ported=yes).

# Row kinds. REPO, FILE, OWNED, PACKAGE, TYPE, EXTERNAL, SKIP, NEC, INSERT_AFTER, DROP_LINE: read as in graph-trie-20261106. DROP_METHOD: <DonorType>.<method> or <DonorType>.<method>(<type>,...) (one overload, parameter types as written in the donor source, generic arguments erased) -> owner -> verdict and evidence; the recipe removes the declaration with its leading Javadoc and annotations. DROP_TYPE: <DonorType>.<NestedType> -> owner -> reason; the same for one nested type declaration. Owner 'closure' = a non-public member only dropped members used.
